description.narrative: Project OrganisationsThe project is implemented with the support of The Union for Professionals, Akademikerförbundet SSR.Labour Research Service (LRS) is supporting the core functions of trade unions such as collective bargaining and organising and helping to link unions with other role-players and constituencies. Their work is influencing policies that will enable workers to fully claim their rights.Akademikerförbundet SSR is the Swedish association for university graduates in public administration, social science, political science, behavioural science, human resource management or social work. The union organises 70,000 members in both the public and private sectors.Other Donors to the OrganisationThe project / organisation is core funded by OPC.Funders and partners: Friedrich Ebert Stiftung (FES) Trade Union Competency Centre, Gender @ Work, the National Skills Fund, the ILO, Solidarity Centre, Joint Gender Fund.Shared rental and infrastructure income: AmaBhungane (investigative journalism NGO) and IFWEA.Modest annual grant: the Labour Research Trust (an LRS sustainability instrument)Project Objective Strategies for, addressing unequal power relations both at both individual and systemic levels" Trade unions have improved strategies for pursuing a diverse and inclusive membership base that includes workers in precarious forms of work, women workers, young workers, foreign migrant workers, LGBTQ workers and people living with disabilities" Trade unions have examples of shifts towards a more gender equal culture that addresses all forms of discrimination in the workplace" Trade unions have improved strategies for dealing with the implications of technology and the future of work for organising and bargaining" Trade unions have improved strategies for
